articles.summary: Marathon Petroleum Corp. (NYSE: MPC) and MPLX LP (NYSE: MPLX) today jointly announced they have entered into a definitive agreement to divest the St. Paul Park, Minnesota, and Mandan, North Dakota, refineries, inclusive of related midstream assets, to CVR Energy, Inc. (NYSE: CVI). Total purchase price is $4.2 billion, plus inventory value and subject to purchase price adjustments. MPC will receive $3.45 billion for the refining assets, excluding inventory value, and MPLX will receive $750 million for the related midstream assets. "Ensuring the long-term competitive position of our portfolio is a strategic commitment," said Maryann Mannen, chairman, president, and chief executive officer of MPC and MPLX. "This divestiture of quality assets in Minnesota and North Dakota advances our strategic priorities of maximizing value creation and meeting our return thresholds.
